newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ericsson sees mobile phone sales 200 mln by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson sees mobile phone sales 200 mln by 2000.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson believes annual total sales of mobile phones will be well above 200 million by the year 2000.
"There will be between 500 and 600 million mobile subscribers at the turn of the century," Johan Syberg, head of the Ericsson unit Mobile Phones and Terminals, told Reuters.
"Sales of mobile phones will of course also increase at the rate of the sharp growth of subscribers."
"If you add to this that people also change mobile phones we expect total sales of mobile phones to be well above 200 million annually."
The phones which will sell at the turn of the century will be available in many more models than currently exist, said Jan Ahrenbring, head of markets of Mobile Phones and Terminals.
"There will be very small phones for private users. There will also be specialised, highly functional phones and very simple phones for children, for example," Ahrenbring said.
